tree.heading: Capability
tree.text: The term “capability” means the ability to provide the means to accomplish one or more tasks under specific conditions and to specific performance standards. A capability may be achieved with any combination of properly planned, organized, equipped, trained, and exercised personnel that achieves the intended outcome.

tree.heading: Credentialed; credentialing
tree.text: The terms “credentialed” and “credentialing” have the meanings given those terms in section 311 of this title.

tree.heading: Hazard
tree.text: The term “hazard” has the meaning given that term under section 5195a(a)(1) of title 42.

tree.heading: Mission assignment
tree.text: The term “mission assignment” means a work order issued to a Federal agency by the Agency, directing completion by that agency of a specified task and setting forth funding, other managerial controls, and guidance.

tree.heading: National preparedness goal
tree.text: The term “national preparedness goal” means the national preparedness goal established under section 743 of this title.

tree.heading: National preparedness system
tree.text: The term “national preparedness system” means the national preparedness system established under section 744 of this title.

tree.heading: National training program
tree.text: The term “national training program” means the national training program established under section 748(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Operational readiness
tree.text: The term “operational readiness” means the capability of an organization, an asset, a system, or equipment to perform the missions or functions for which it is organized or designed.

tree.heading: Performance measure
tree.text: The term “performance measure” means a quantitative or qualitative characteristic used to gauge the results of an outcome compared to its intended purpose.

tree.heading: Performance metric
tree.text: The term “performance metric” means a particular value or characteristic used to measure the outcome that is generally expressed in terms of a baseline and a target.

tree.heading: Prevention
tree.text: The term “prevention” means any activity undertaken to avoid, prevent, or stop a threatened or actual act of terrorism.

tree.heading: Resources
tree.text: The term “resources” has the meaning given that term in section 311 of this title.

tree.heading: Type
tree.text: The term “type” means a classification of resources that refers to the capability of a resource.

tree.heading: Typed; typing
tree.text: The terms “typed” and “typing” have the meanings given those terms in section 311 of this title.

notes.text: Amendments2007—Pars. (2) to (14). Pub. L. 110–53 added pars. (2) and (12) to (14) and redesignated former pars. (2) to (10) as (3) to (11), respectively.
